messages:
DeployBot: Canary rollout initiated for inference-service@v1.14-canary (commit f0a1d22) -> gradual 15% traffic. Started 11:13 UTC.
IncidentBot: ALERT: increased_inference_error_rate for /v1/complete on canary cohort. Paging Marin (oncall) via PagerDuty. SEV: high.
Marin (oncall): Acknowledged. Pulling logs and metrics. Which customers were in the canary routing?
Priya: Two VIP dedicated customers (Acct-Lambda, Acct-Omega) had routing override. Seeing a mix of high latency and malformed responses (truncated JSON bodies), not typical 5xx.
Tess (SRE): Sample log: 
```
2026-04-02T11:14:12Z canary-2 inference: write_failed: short_write when streaming chunk; response-truncated=true; model-run-time=0.9s
2026-04-02T11:14:13Z canary-4 runtime: quantize-loader: mismatched-chunk-size expected=4096 got=3072
```
Marin (oncall): Hmm quantize-loader mismatch. Could be the new quantization packaging in this build. Priya, flip the canary-routing flag to stop dedicated traffic to canary.
Priya: Hitting flag kill: `POST /flags/kill {"flag":"canary-routing","env":"prod"}` -> 200 OK. OpsBot applying reweight now.
OpsBot: Traffic reweight done: canary -> 0%, stable -> 100%. Propagation ~25s.
NotifBot: Notifying on-call rotation: Marin -> Tess in 10m for handoff (auto-notify).
Marin (oncall): Pause rollout and disable auto-promote. DeployBot, pause.
DeployBot: Canary rollout paused by ops. Auto-promote disabled.
Tess (SRE): Looking at the canary image diff (f0a1d22): includes a packaged quantization table change + a new build step that strips padding. Reproducer: feed the model a sequence with length mod 1024 != 0 -> loader fails.
Carlos (Product): Customer impact? Any 4xx/5xx spikes in monitoring?
Priya: No large 5xx spike, but ACCT-Lambda saw ~18% of requests with truncated responses between 11:1311:18 UTC. Estimated impact window ~5 minutes. No data exfiltration or errors returned at API layer, just truncated bodies.
Marin (oncall): We need a fast revert of the packaging change. What's the smallest revert?
Tess (SRE): The packaging change came in commit f0a1d22 and touches two build files. Fast path: revert that single commit and trigger hotfix pipeline. Alternative is to patch runtime to accept shorter chunks but revert is faster.
Marin (oncall): Do the revert. Priya, create revert commit and kick hotfix. I'll keep pager until stable confirmed.
Priya: `git revert --no-edit f0a1d22 && git push origin main` -> revert commit created: revert-f0a1d22 (hash e2b7c9f). Triggering hotfix build 2073 -> image v1.14.1-hotfix.
DeployBot: Hotfix canary deploy started at 11:22 UTC -> 10% traffic to canary pods.
IncidentBot: Monitoring window enabled: truncated_response_rate, p95 latency, and error_count for next 20 minutes. Alert if truncated_response_rate > 0.5%.
QA-Bot: Running smoke: synthetic requests with varied token lengths. Before revert: 12/50 truncated; after revert canary: 0/50 truncated.
Tess (SRE): Initial hotfix canary metrics look clean. No truncated responses, p95 within baseline. If this holds for 12m, promote.
Carlos (Product): I'll prepare a customer note for Acct-Lambda and Acct-Omega with impact window and mitigation. Hold until we confirm promotion.
Marin (oncall): After reweight to stable, customer impact dropped to baseline in ~40s. So final customer impact window ~11:1311:18 UTC. Keep that in notes.
Tess (SRE): Root cause: new packaging step removed zero-padding expected by legacy quantize-loader, causing loader to miscalculate chunk sizes. Fix path: revert packaging and add CI check for chunk-size invariants. Also add canary synthetic test across token-length mod distributions.
Priya: Promotion scheduled for 11:36 UTC if health holds. Refs: revert e2b7c9f, build 2073, deploy job 8821.
Marin (oncall): Handoff incident to Tess for postmortem. Action items: 1) CI check for quantize packaging 2) pre-rollout canary tests for mod-n token lengths 3) flag gating in pipeline to prevent packaging changes from hitting stable without extra gate.
Tess (SRE): Taking ownership. Will write up postmortem and assign owners. ETA: 48 hours.
Carlos (Product): I'll send the customer notification to account ops with the impact window and note that a hotfix has been deployed.
Marin (oncall): Closing active pager; I'll stay on thread until promotion confirmed. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
